original: 絶対コレいけるって！\nお宝の予感がする〜！\nチャ〜〜ンス！
traducao: This is definitely it!\nI can smell the treasure!\nChaaaance!

original: 確かに、紙質やインクの感じからして\n結構な年代モノっぽいわね……
traducao: Judging by the paper and ink,\nit definitely looks like an antique...

original: う〜ん、何かワクワクしてきたわ！\nこの山、乗った♪
traducao: Hmm, I'm getting excited!\nI'm in for this trip~

original: よっしゃー！\nそう来なくっちゃー！\nき〜まりっ！
traducao: Alright!\nThat's the spirit!\nIt's decided!

original: んじゃアンジュ、ちょっくら\n依頼出させてよ〜
traducao: Well then, Ange,\nlet me post the request~

original: そうね、面白そう
traducao: Sounds interesting.

original: せっかくだし、\nわたしも乗っかってみようかな
traducao: Since we're at it,\nmaybe I should tag along too.

original: あら。\nリーダーにしては珍しく\n積極的じゃない
traducao: Oh my.\nIt's rare for the leader\nto be so proactive.

original: うふふ。\nその代わり報酬は\nきっちり山分けって事で、どう？
traducao: Fufu.\nBut in exchange, the reward\nwill be split evenly, how about it?

original: ぐぬぬぅ、そう来たか……
traducao: Ugh, so that's how it is...

original: い、いーわよ別に。\nそれでいきましょ！
traducao: F-Fine by me.\nLet's do this!

original: 目が泳いでるね、ノーマ
traducao: Your eyes are wandering, Norma.

original: 嘘を吐いたら、契約不履行で\n除名処分も辞さないけれど……
traducao: If you lie to me, I won't hesitate to\nexpel you for breach of contract...

original: そんな不名誉な肩書きが付いたら、\n他のギルドでももう\n雇ってもらえなくなっちゃうかもね？
traducao: If you get such a dishonorable title,\nyou might not be able to get hired\nby other guilds anymore, you know?

original: 均等に山分けでいいと思いまーす
traducao: I think an equal split is perfect.

original: アンジュも何だかんだで\nちゃっかりしてるわよねぇ
traducao: Ange is pretty shrewd\nwhen it comes down to it, huh.

original: 最近は人も増えて、何かと物入りだから。\nこれくらいは、ね
traducao: We've got more people recently,\nso we have a lot of expenses.

original: で、どうするの？\nあたし達三人だけで行く？
traducao: So, what's the plan?\nAre we going with just the three of us?

original: いえ、ボディガードを一人雇いましょう。\nわたしにちょっと心当たりがあるの。\n任せておいて
traducao: No, let's hire a bodyguard.\nI have someone in mind.\nLeave it to me.

original: クエスト「報酬の価値」が\nエントリーされました。\nクエストカウンタから受ける事が出来ます
traducao: The quest 'Worth the Reward'\nhas been added.\nYou can accept it at the Quest Counter.

original: ○○、\nきっと引き受けてくれるって\n思ってたよ
traducao: ○○,\nI knew you'd\naccept it.

original: なるほどね〜……。\n確かに○○なら\n腕も確かだし
traducao: I see...\nWell, if it's ○○,\ntheir skills are reliable.

original: いいんじゃない？
traducao: Sounds good to me.

original: （もしこれが、ただのお宝じゃなくて\n　伝説のあのお宝の地図だったり\n　しちゃったら……）
traducao: (If this isn't just normal treasure,\nbut the map to that legendary treasure,\nthen I'd be...)

original: （このひかえめな胸を、\n　ばい〜んってしてやるんだから！）
traducao: (I'm gonna make this flat chest\nbai~n! I'm telling you!)

original: 何か言った？
traducao: Did you say something?

original: ん〜ん〜、な〜んも！\nちょっと気合入れてただけ∀
traducao: N-No, nothing!\nJust psyching myself up!

original: んじゃ、早速目的地に出発〜！
traducao: Well then, let's head to our destination!

original: く〜〜っ。\n何だか燃えて来たぁ！！
traducao: Kuuh.\nI'm getting fired up now!!

original: 燃えるのはいいけど、\nあまり先走らない様にね？
traducao: Being fired up is fine,\nbut don't get too ahead of yourself.

original: そうそう。\n今はとにかく、確実にお宝を\n手に入れる事を考えましょ
traducao: Exactly.\nFor now, just focus on\nsecurely getting the treasure.

original: お宝ざっくざく……。\nガルドの海で泳げちゃうかも∀
traducao: A mountain of treasure...\nI might be able to swim in gald!
Aaaah, I can't wait!!

original: って、全然聞いてないわね。\nこの子……
traducao: She's not listening at all...\nThis girl...

original: それにしても、ここまで割と\n何の問題もなく来ちゃったけど……
traducao: Still, we've made it this far\nwithout any issues...

original: 本当に大丈夫なの？　その地図
traducao: Is that map really okay?

original: 普通、お宝が眠ってる場所っていったら、\n盗掘犯向けにトラップとか、\nビシバシ仕掛けられてるもんじゃない？
traducao: Usually, a place where treasure sleeps\nis packed with traps for grave robbers,\nisn't it?

original: なにお〜う！　あたしを疑うのっ？\nひど過ぎるよ！　ひど過ぎたよ！\n世知辛過ぎ！　切な過ぎ！
traducao: What!? Are you doubting me!?\nThat's too cruel! Too cruel!\nToo harsh! Too heartbreaking!

original: あ〜も〜、アンジュ〜〜〜。\n優しく、慰めて〜
traducao: Aaaah, Angeeee.\nComfort me~

original: はいはい、おいで
traducao: There, there. Come here.

original: そうよ、これよこれ∀\nふわふわでふにふにであったかくて……
traducao: Yes, this is it!\nIt's soft and squishy and warm...

original: だ〜〜もう、たまら〜〜ん！！
traducao: Aaah, I can't get enough of this!!

original: そんなに喜んでもらえるなんて、\n嬉しいな
traducao: I'm glad you enjoy it\nthat much.

original: 前から思ってたけど、アンジュってさ〜\nイイ体してるよね〜∀
traducao: I've always thought this,\nbut Ange, you have a great body~

original: 抱き心地が最高過ぎ。\nあ〜もうあたし、このまま動きたくない。\n寝ちゃいたい
traducao: It feels amazing to hug you.\nAh man, I don't want to move anymore.\nI want to sleep.

original: あのねぇ、ここへ来た目的を忘れてない？\nお宝はどうなったのよ、お宝は！
traducao: Hey, didn't you forget why we came here?\nWhat happened to the treasure!?

original: はっ！\nそうだったーーー！！！
traducao: Gasp!\nThat's riiiiight!!!

original: もちろん、こうしてたっぷり休憩した分\nこれからキリキリ働くんだよね？
traducao: Of course, since you've rested fully,\nyou'll work extra hard from now on, right?

original: うっ。\nそ、そりゃあもう……
traducao: Ugh.\nY-Yeah, of course...

original: うふふ。\nさ、それじゃ行きましょう
traducao: Fufu.\nWell then, let's go.

original: （完全にノーマを\n　コントロールしてるってわけね……）
traducao: (She completely has Norma\nunder her control...)

original: （アンジュ……なかなかやり手だわ）
traducao: (Ange... she's quite something.)

original: これよ、これ！\nついにお宝とご対面〜〜〜っ
traducao: This is it, this is it!\nFinally, we found the treasure~

original: ほんとにあったわ……！
traducao: It was really here...!

original: 開けた瞬間に発動するトラップも……。\nうん、どうやらなさそうね
traducao: Is there a trap that triggers on open...?\nYeah, doesn't seem like it.

original: は〜い！　みんな！\nあたしにちゅ〜も〜く！！
traducao: Alright! Everyone!\nPay attention to me!!

original: んじゃ、開けるよ？\nせ〜〜のっ！
traducao: Well then, I'm opening it!\nReady, set...!

original: これ、って……
traducao: Is this...

original: えーと……。\nどう見ても、おもちゃ……\nに、見えるけど？
traducao: Let's see...\nNo matter how you look at it,\nit looks like a toy...?

original: おっ、まだ他に何か入ってる！\nなになに、この紙束……って
traducao: Oh, there's more inside!\nLet's see, this bundle of papers...

original: あ〜、何だと〜！！\nテストの答案！？
traducao: Ah, what the heck!!\nTest papers!?

original: ……どうやら、お宝はお宝でも\n個人にとっての「お宝」だったみたいね
traducao: ...It seems like this treasure is\na 'treasure' to someone personally.

original: ノーマが見つけたのは、\nタイムカプセルの地図だったみたい。\nほら、一緒に入ってたこの手紙に書いてある
traducao: It looks like the map Norma found\nwas for a time capsule.\nLook, it's written in this letter inside.

original: 何よそれ。\nここまで来てそういうオチなわけ？
traducao: What's with that.\nWe came all this way just for this?

original: はぁ〜〜〜……。\n信っじらんない……
traducao: Haaaa...\nUnbelievable...

original: そう？\nまあ、こういう事もあるでしょう
traducao: Is that so?\nWell, things like this happen.

original: それに、百戦錬磨の二人の事だから\nこれくらいの失敗で挫けたりなんて\nしないよね？
traducao: Besides, you two are seasoned veterans,\nyou wouldn't get discouraged by\na failure like this, right?

original: げげっ！？　そこでこっちに振る？
traducao: Geh!? You're throwing that at me!?

original: ……ま、ま〜〜ねっ！\nあたしくらいになれば、このくらい\n慣れっこだもんねっ！！
traducao: ...W-Well yeah!\nFor someone like me,\nI'm totally used to this!!

original: ま、確かにこれくらいのガセネタは\nこれまでにもあったしね
traducao: Well, we've definitely had our share\nof fake leads before.

original: さすがにそう簡単には\n上手くいかないって事か
traducao: I guess things don't\nalways go that easily.

original: お金を稼ぎたかったら、\nありもしない夢にすがるより\n地道にコツコツ貯金をしなさいって事かな
traducao: If you want to earn money,\ninstead of clinging to pipe dreams,\nyou should steadily save up.

original: あら。\n何だか、いいお説教のネタに\n出来そうかも
traducao: Oh my.\nSomehow, this feels like\ngood material for a sermon.

original: さすが、そういうところは\n職業病よね……
traducao: As expected,\nthat's an occupational hazard...

original: あ〜〜〜ん……。\nあたしのお宝ぁ〜〜〜〜
traducao: Aaaargh...\nMy treasureee...

original: ばい〜〜〜ん、が……
traducao: My bai~~~n...

original: 今回は残念な結果だったけど、\nあまり気落ちしないで\n次にやるべき事を考えていきましょ
traducao: It was a disappointing result this time,\nbut don't be too discouraged,\nlet's think about what to do next.

original: へ〜いへいへい……
traducao: Yeeeaaah...

original: そうねぇ。\n今度こそ、しっかりキッチリ\n稼げる仕事をしないとね
traducao: That's right.\nNext time, we have to do\na job that really pays.

original: 落ち込んでなんていらんないわ
traducao: We don't have time to be depressed.

original: そうそう。\nその意気、その意気
traducao: Yes, yes.\nThat's the spirit.

original: あのさぁ、この辺で\n古い地図の落とし物見なかった？
traducao: Hey, have you seen an old map\nlying around here?

original: 古い地図？
traducao: An old map?

original: うん。　ちょっと部屋の掃除してたら\n懐かしいものが出て来てさぁ。\nそれがその地図なんだけど……
traducao: Yeah. I was cleaning my room a bit\nand found something nostalgic.\nAnd it was that map...

original: 掃除してるうちに\nどっかにいっちゃった\nみたいなんだよね
traducao: I think I must have\nmisplaced it somewhere\nwhile I was cleaning.

original: あ〜あ。\n思い出の詰まった、タイムカプセルの\n地図だったのにぃ……
traducao: Aah.\nAnd it was the map to my time capsule\nfilled with memories...

original: それって、もしかして……
traducao: Wait, could it be...

original: ノーマ？\nどこへ行くつもりなのかな
traducao: Norma?\nWhere are you planning to go?

original: にょがっ
traducao: Guh!

original: え？　いや、別に……。\nそうだ、ト、トイレ！
traducao: Eh? N-No, nowhere...\nOh right, the b-bathroom!

original: 少し我慢なさい
traducao: Hold it in for a bit.

original: それで？\nどういう事か説明してくれる？
traducao: So?\nCare to explain what's going on?

original: だ〜〜もう！\nちょっと借りただけなの〜〜！！
traducao: Aaaargh!\nI just borrowed it for a little bit!!

original: もうし〜ま〜せ〜ん〜〜〜！！
traducao: I'm sooorryyyy!!
